pairs.subject: agent-memory
pairs.evidence: src/lib/prompt-context.ts:399 The shared header injects the build-error memory only when a non-empty list is passed. When nothing is passed, or the recall failed, the section is silently left out, so the agent cannot tell 'no past errors' from 'memory not consulted or unavailable'.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/prompt-context.ts:399 Empty recall and failed or absent recall render identically (no section, no status line). The technique requires the two zero-item outcomes to be spelled differently. The section label itself ('Past Build Errors (avoid repeating these)', line 253) does mark the material as memory.

src/lib/prompt-context.ts:374 A repo-wide search shows no caller ever supplies errorMemory: it appears only in types, here, and as a pass-through in prompt-builder.ts:70, and the API's 'get-relevant-errors' action has no caller. Errors recorded by build-pipeline therefore never reach any prompt, and the silent default leaves no notice of the omission.

src/types/prompt-evolution.ts:158 Each run is served exactly one variant, and the trial is booked to that arm only. Outcome credit goes to the item that ran, not to everything shown. VerdictBasis 'judge' | 'self-reported' (line 121) names the evidence channel.

pairs.subject: agent-memory
pairs.evidence: src/lib/visual-gen/style-dna-db.ts:84 A vision-model distillation (the Style DNA) is persisted and injected into every later generation prompt. The row keeps only a count of source images: no image ids, no distiller model, no raw reply (the raw reply lives only in the in-memory job). A consolidated belief that is asserted on every call therefore cannot answer 'from what'.

techniques.evidence: src/lib/visual-gen/style-dna-db.ts:84 The distilled item is stored without provenance rows (grounding images, distiller, raw reply). The pass does refuse to write fake or empty DNA on a parse failure (style-dna-job-store.ts:76), which is the correct one-door behaviour.

src/lib/visual-gen/style-dna.ts:113 When the user prompt is long, the recalled style fragment is truncated mid-item at the 1500-character cap instead of being skipped or packed whole ('never truncate an item'). The fragment is labeled as project style (line 72) and capped per dimension (FRAGMENT_CAP, line 66).

src/lib/visual-gen/style-dna-db.ts:56 A corrupt or mis-shaped dna row throws, or is cast without shape validation, on the read path used for prompt injection (getActiveStyleDna / listStyleDna). The read does not degrade and report 'unavailable'; one bad row also fails the whole list. Callers outside the context were not checked for a catch.

src/lib/visual-gen/style-dna-db.ts:108 An operator correction (fork) is saved through the same door with the parent's sourceImageCount and no origin or authorship marker. A hand-edited style is therefore indistinguishable from a model-distilled one: the correction is not marked operator-issued, and 'who wrote you' has no answer. The fork does preserve the parent (undo), which is good.
